_comment: RJ-0080 (adp-0223); six-phase realignment 8 Oct 2026. Section 5's own words: 'the field lists are kept as data beside the render tool (one list per produce step), so a change to the generator or to land.md that adds a read without adding it to the list fails a test.' Every gate/field pair below is taken directly from the named tool's or command's own code in the six-phase model, read in full this job, never from memory. '[]' in a field path means 'for each item in this array'.

fields.note: requireGate(manifest,'onb-04_naming'): the gate must exist with a closed record carrying a decidedValue; the slug and display name are read from it.
fallback read only when manifest.slug (top-level, not a gate field) is absent; fails by name if both are absent.
first half of the derived page/course display title (pathwayName: tierName); tolerated absent (filter(Boolean)).
second half of the derived display title; tolerated absent (filter(Boolean)) - a field the generator reads but onb-04_naming's own decidedValueShape does not require.
requireGate(manifest,'crs-04_lesson-map'); fails by name if lessons is missing or empty. Each key becomes a lesson page.
les-01 (MK-1): this lesson's own coupledSlots, read at /land time to decide the _classes slot marker on each block it writes.
MK-1: a slot whose variationType is not shell-coupled gets the marker; same coupledSlots entry.
les-01 authors the lesson's learning-outcomes component from its crs-04 entry's outcomes (BW-1/LF-1 carried to crs-04); its formative check names one via 'tests' (AL-6).
wra-03 summative items ('tests') and wra-04 confidence statements ('rates') each name a course outcome id here.
